comparison.objective: Scoop more than four beads from a tray into a bowl.
comparison.physical_skill: Collect several loose spheres in one scoop and transport them without spilling.
comparison.success_condition: At least five beads must settle in the bowl for one second; lower counts earn partial credit.
comparison.reason: This tests bulk scooping and transport of loose beads. The candidate's balls remain functional internal bearing elements whose uninterrupted physical containment during rail transfer is the tested outcome.
